_help: DISTANCE // ZERO programme 2027. The only file to edit when an episode is announced.
Every Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 'regularFrom' to 'until' is generated automatically from 'formats' (weekday: 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday, 0 = Sunday).
To announce an episode, add (or edit) its date under 'episodes'. Leave out what is not confirmed: nothing is shown for it.
title         episode title, e.g. "DJ Andy'K: Deep Connections (Official Version)"
details       text about the episode: one string, or a list of paragraphs
note          one highlighted line under the details, e.g. "Next evening: …"
time          start time in VIENNA time, 24 h, e.g. "20:00". Melbourne time is calculated automatically, daylight saving included.
minutes       length, needed for Add to Calendar (default 120)
watchUrl      link to the live stream: shows WATCH LIVE
recordingUrl  link to the recording: shows WATCH THE RECORDING
calendar      true shows ADD TO CALENDAR (only works once 'time' is set)
cancelled     true marks the date as cancelled
Dates are Vienna dates. Buttons only appear once their link or time is filled in.

2027-01-29.title: DJ Andy’K presents: DEEP CONNECTIONS (Official Version)
details: Experience Deep Connections in its original electronic form.
DJ Andy’K revisits his 2026 house and progressive house album, bringing its rhythms, melodies and emotional atmosphere into the DISTANCE // ZERO live-show experience.
Join the conversation, discover the story behind the music and experience the album in its original sound.
2027-01-29.note: Next evening: Deep Connections returns in a completely different form — Piano Edition.

2027-01-30.title: DJ Andy’K presents: DEEP CONNECTIONS (Piano Edition)
details: One album. A completely different musical experience.
Originally created in the world of house and progressive house, Deep Connections is reimagined through the intimate sound of the piano.
DJ Andy’K hosts this special live session, sharing the stories and emotions behind the songs while a cinematic virtual grand piano brings the arrangements to life.
The full album will be presented in piano arrangements, excluding the original album intro.
Viewers can join the live chat, ask questions and discover the original recordings on djandykofficial.com or their preferred streaming platform.
2027-01-30.note: No original electronic recordings will be played during the piano concert.
